시편-121-1.title: 시편 121장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-121-1.exegesis: 6-7. While those who surrounded him were maliciously hostile, he was disposed to peace. This Psalm may well begin such a series as this, as a contrast to the promised joys of God's worship.
시편-121-1.theologicalNote: 6-7. While those who surrounded him were maliciously hostile, he was disposed to peace. This Psalm may well begin such a series as this, as a contrast to the promised joys of God's worship.

시편-121-7.title: 시편 121장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-121-7.exegesis: 6-8. God keeps His people at all times and in all perils. nor the moon by night-- poetically represents the dangers of the night, over which the moon presides ( Ge 1:16 ).
